meta.title: Save a prompt's conditioning
meta.about: Encode once and write the result to a file. Move it from the output folder to models/embeddings and Load Conditioning can use it with no text encoder.
needs: An SD 1.5 checkpoint in models/checkpoints (we used v1-5-pruned-emaonly). Any SD 1.5 file works; pick yours in the loader.

notes.10: Writes safetensors. One conditioning entry only: save it before combining.

inputs.text: a weathered brass astrolabe on an oak table, warm window light, photograph
